method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Oil Wavers and Stocks Sink After Wave of Strikes Across Middle East
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shocks in the Middle East are driving risk-off sentiment and equity weakness via higher oil/energy-risk premia and flight-to-safety flows — broad market negative with high relevance.

Equities.title: Foreign outflows from Asian equities surge on Middle East risks, tech rout
Equities.reason: Confirms cross-border deleveraging and fund outflows tied to geopolitical risk and tech weakness — reinforces regional/market-wide risk-off narrative and raises downside for Asian equities.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Tech-led swings as AI exuberance cools – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid describes a volatile session for US equities, with a sharp intraday tech sell-off largely reversing by the close. The S&P 500 and NASDAQ finished modestly lower, while semiconductors underperformed.
Equities.reason: Captures the dominant equity narrative of AI-led volatility — tech leadership cooling creates intraday swings and raises market risk premia.

Equities.title: Oracle Earnings Pose Next Test for Suddenly Shaky AI Stock Rally
Equities.reason: Earnings from large AI-exposed names are immediate catalysts that could validate or extend the nascent pullback in AI-led leadership; relevant to near-term market direction.

Equities.title: US stock market to stop shrinking for first time in 23 years
Equities.summary: Market debuts of SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI plus slowing buybacks could remove vital support for equities, investors warn
Equities.reason: Structural shift — large IPO wave and slower buybacks reduce a key liquidity/support mechanism for US equities, a material bearish regime change for market internals.

Equities.title: India Stock Fund Flows Drop Most in Three Years as War Drags On
Equities.reason: Emerging-market equity vulnerability to geopolitical shock shown in sharp fall in India inflows — signals broader EM susceptibility and risk-off transmission to global equities.

Equities.title: Korea’s Kospi Extends Losses on Chipmakers, War-Tied Jitters
Equities.reason: Illustrates regional tech/semi weakness amplified by geopolitical jitters — semiconductor weakness is a key channel for global equity underperformance.

Equities.title: SoftBank sinks over 8% as Asia tech stocks tumble, tracking Wall Street losses
Equities.summary: Asian semiconductor and technology stocks fell on Wednesday, tracking overnight losses on Wall Street.
Equities.reason: Large-cap Asian tech selloff mirrors US tech weakness and contributes to regional equity declines — reinforces cross-market spillover risk.

Equities.title: Anthropic releases Mythos-like AI model to the public two months after private rollout rocked Wall Street
Equities.summary: Anthropic said the broad release is possible because of new safeguards that block responses in specific high-risk areas.
Equities.reason: Wider availability of advanced AI models supports the secular AI narrative and long-term tech investment case, a modest positive counterbalance to near-term volatility.

Equities.title: JPMorgan Chase plans to deploy more powerful AI agents this year
Equities.summary: JPMorgan Chase's move suggests long-running AI agents are close to clearing the security and governance hurdles that have slowed adoption inside big companies.
Equities.reason: Major financial institution moving to deploy AI agents underlines corporate adoption across industries — supportive for AI-related equity segments over time.

Equities.title: Korea Stock Hedging Surges to Level That Warned of Past Selloffs
Equities.reason: Rising hedging activity signals elevated investor risk aversion and potential for further equity downside — a tactical warning for market participants.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Core CPI focus keeps DXY supported – ING
Rates.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes the Dollar is holding recent gains as markets await the US May CPI report, with expectations that firm core inflation will keep Federal Reserve hike pricing alive into December.
Rates.reason: Direct link to US inflation and Fed pricing — supports higher-for-longer US rate expectations and US yield upside (bond negative). High relevance given imminent CPI.

Rates.title: US Dollar Index: CPI and geopolitics underpin strength – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan highlights that a potentially hotter US CPI print could reinforce expectations of higher-for-longer US interest rates, underpinning broad US Dollar strength.
Rates.reason: Reinforces the market narrative that a hotter US CPI would push Fed policy expectations and US yields higher — negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: US CPI data expected to show inflation hit a three-year high, driven by high Oil prices
Rates.summary: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will publish the May Consumer Price Index (CPI) data on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Headline expectation of a large CPI print is highly market-moving for rates — would materially lift Fed hiking/small-for-longer bets and push yields higher (strong negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Energy prices take center stage as the ECB prepares to decide on rates
Rates.summary: The ECB is expected to raise rates by 25 basis points as higher energy prices drive inflation and raise concerns about broader price pressures.
Rates.reason: Explicit central-bank decision (ECB likely 25bp hike) driven by energy — raises euro-area yields and supports a higher-for-longer global rates backdrop (bond negative).

Rates.title: BoC set to hold interest rate as inflation remains high but economy wobbles
Rates.summary: The Bank of Canada (BoC) is widely expected to keep its policy rate unchanged at 2.25% on Wednesday. This would be the fifth consecutive gathering with the bank keeping its hand steady.
Rates.reason: A BoC hold (versus hikes priced elsewhere) is mildly supportive for Canadian bond prices (yields slightly lower) — limited market impact relative to global US/ECB inflation narrative.

Rates.title: Hungarian Forint: Softer CPI opens door to rate cuts – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose highlights that Hungarian inflation has fallen below the lower bound of the MNB’s tolerance range, with underlying measures remaining within target.
Rates.reason: Domestic disinflation opens path to MNB cuts — positive for Hungarian bond prices (yields down). EM/sovereign-specific and lower relevance to global rates.

Rates.title: China's May producer inflation highest in nearly 4 years, consumer prices also rise
Rates.reason: Higher PPI/CPIs in China raise global inflation/import-price pressures and add to upward pressure on global yields — moderate relevance to G7 rates.

Rates.title: Governments Are Selling Bonds at Record Pace as Spending Soars
Rates.reason: Record sovereign issuance increases bond supply and puts upward pressure on yields — a clear negative for bond prices and an important structural driver for rates.

Rates.title: Japan’s 30-Year Bond Sale Draws Weakest Demand Since June 2025
Rates.reason: Weak demand at a long-JGB auction signals upside risk for Japanese yields and potential de-anchoring of bond-market liquidity — negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: DP World Meets Bond Investors to Allay Worries Over War’s Impact
Rates.reason: Company outreach to bondholders reflects war-driven credit/supply concerns; adds to near-term risk premia and volatility in credit and sovereign curves (mildly negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: BlackRock warns of energy shock as May CPI is set to show acceleration in inflation
Rates.reason: Institutional warning linking energy shock to CPI upside — supports higher rate expectations and adds to near-term yield pressure (negative for bonds), but lower relevance than primary CPI/central-bank pieces.

FX.title: Euro: Gains hinge on domestic demand – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that recent EUR/USD support has come mainly from cross-border investors reducing hedges after the European Central Bank's (ECB) hawkish shift, bringing aggregate Euro holdings back to flat.
FX.reason: ECB hawkish shift and hedge-reduction flows are a clear EUR-support story vs USD; this reinforces a modest euro-strength / USD-weakness narrative for the USD-centric FX basket.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Downside risks versus USD with BoC on hold – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale analysts note USD/CAD has broken key technical resistance and could extend higher as the Bank of Canada (BoC) is expected to keep rates unchanged at 2.25%.
FX.reason: BoC on hold + technical breakout implies further USD/CAD upside (CAD weakness / USD strength). That feeds the broader USD-strength theme against commodity FX and is a material domestic-policy FX driver.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah: BI tightening to defend IDR – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Charlie Lay reports that Bank Indonesia delivered a surprise off-cycle 25 bp hike to 5.50%, reinforcing its focus on Rupiah stability through higher rates and FX intervention.
FX.reason: An off-cycle 25bp BI hike is a clear policy intervention to support IDR; high relevance for EMFX flows and reduces USD upside vs IDR (local-currency strengthening narrative).

FX.title: Sri Lankan Rupee Surges 2% on Central Bank Measure to Support FX
FX.reason: Central-bank action that delivered a ~2% FX move is high-impact for that local currency; this is a clear EMFX-support story (local currency strengthening vs USD).

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Weakens gradually against US Dollar toward 160.75 – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe USD/JPY as range-bound intraday between 159.90 and 160.40 after a brief spike and reversal, but maintain a slightly positive multi-day stance.
FX.reason: UOB's tilt to a positive USD/JPY multi-day stance reinforces JPY weakness and therefore USD strength in the USD-centric basket; JPY moves matter for global FX volatility and safe-haven flows.

FX.title: British Pound: Further downside risk toward 1.3240 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note GBP/USD remains under pressure after last week’s plunge, with scope for another test of 1.3300 before a recovery.
FX.reason: UOB flags continued GBP downside vs USD, adding to the theme of USD strength vs major currencies; technical/short-term risk view with moderate relevance.

FX.title: Experts agree: RBA’s next move will likely be an interest-rate cut, not a hike
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) underperforms its major currency pairs during the European trading session on Wednesday, trading 0.25% lower to near 0.7010 against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: RBA-tilt toward cuts implies AUD underperformance vs USD; reinforces the broader USD-strength / commodity-currency weakness narrative.

FX.title: Yes Bank Hikes FX Deposit Rates to Attract Non-Resident Inflows
FX.reason: Bank-level move to attract non-resident FX deposits is likely to support INR flows and reduce near-term USD demand for India; relevant for INR and cross-border USD flows but smaller in global FX context.

FX.title: Experts agree: Canadian Dollar’s downside pressure may be about to ease
FX.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) is hovering near the upper boundaries of its year-to-date range against the US Dollar, underperforming as one of the weakest major currencies in recent weeks.
FX.reason: A tentative contrarian view that CAD downside could ease is a low-relevance counter-signal to the USD/CAD-up narrative (keeps overall CAD/BoC-driven story balanced).

Commodities.title: Gold languishes near March low, below $4,200 as traders await US CPI report
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its heavily offered tone through the first half of the European session and currently trades near its lowest level since March 23, around the $4,180-$4,175 region.
Commodities.reason: Gold selling tied to hawkish rate-bet narrative ahead of US CPI; yields up is a clear negative for bullion and is market-wide.

Commodities.title: Oil: Hormuz risks and hidden flows – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank’s Global Strategist Michael Every highlights that Oil prices fell as the United States (US) energy secretary reported rising Hormuz transits, with evidence the US Navy may be moving more crude through the Strait than official data show.
Commodities.reason: Analysis argues rising Hormuz transits/hidden flows have reduced near-term risk premium, a modest bearish signal for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil choppy after U.S. completes Iran strikes following Apache helicopter attack
Commodities.summary: Oil prices rose after the U.S. launched military strikes against Iran, raising concerns that renewed clashes may threaten shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Fresh US-Iran strikes raise shipping/supply-risk premium through Hormuz — supportive for crude with clear geopolitical tail-risk.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas storage capacity increased slightly in 2025
Commodities.summary: Underground working natural gas storage capacity in the Lower 48 states increased slightly in 2025, according to our latest data, with growth concentrated in the South Central and Mountain regions. Underground natural gas storage provides a source of energy wh
Commodities.reason: Incremental increase in US gas storage capacity modestly eases price sensitivity to shocks — a small bearish structural signal for NG.

Commodities.title: Copper: Mixed China signals and positioning shifts – ING
Commodities.summary: ING’s Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey say China’s latest trade data for Copper are mixed, with higher unwrought Copper imports in May but lower year-to-date volumes due to stronger domestic refined output.
Commodities.reason: China data are mixed; higher May imports offset by YTD weakness from refined output — marginally bearish/neutral for copper demand narrative.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD finds temporary support near $63.50; downside remains likely
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) rebounds to near $65.00 in the European trading session on Wednesday after attracting bids at around over the two-month low of $63.45 earlier in the day.
Commodities.reason: Silver tracking gold weakness and rate-hike sensitivity; technicals show lower low risk — bearish for precious metals complex.

Commodities.title: Suez Canal Gets Oil-Tanker Boost Amid Hormuz Strait Shutdown
Commodities.reason: Re-routing/extra tanker demand via Suez amid Hormuz disruption implies higher shipping costs and a supportive supply-risk premium for oil.

Commodities.title: Physical Oil Markets Are Floundering Despite 100 Days of War
Commodities.reason: Describes market dislocations in physical crude markets; signals fragmentation/liquidity issues that can cap near-term price moves — modestly negative.

Commodities.title: Oil climbs as US-Iran tensions flare again while stockpiles tighten
Commodities.reason: Combination of renewed US-Iran clashes and tightening inventories is a clear bullish oil fundamental — strong positive for prices and risk premium.

Commodities.title: Gold Extends Fall as Renewed US-Iran Clashes Test Fragile Truce
Commodities.reason: Gold under pressure as rate-hike/US CPI and hawkish expectations dominate despite geopolitical risk; strong negative for bullion.

Commodities.title: Oil Climbs After Fresh US Strikes on Iran Over Helicopter Attack
Commodities.reason: Fresh US strikes increase supply-risk premium and lift oil — reinforces the bullish geopolitical-led oil narrative.

Commodities.title: Energy Secretary Chris Wright says traffic in Strait of Hormuz is rising 'very meaningfully'
Commodities.summary: Wright said that describing the volume of oil exports out of Hormuz as increasing is a "fair statement."
Commodities.reason: Official comment that Hormuz traffic is rising suggests higher physical flows/hidden shipments — a countervailing bearish signal for oil risk premium.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin inflows slow sharply in 2026 as investors chase AI, Bernstein says
Crypto.reason: Large institutional flow shift away from BTC toward AI equities = meaningful negative for crypto demand and ETF inflows; broad market allocation headwind for BTC.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs are no bigger today than when Trump won the election
Crypto.reason: Argues ETFs have not materially expanded investor base — negative for BTC liquidity/adoption narrative and ETF-led price case.

Crypto.title: Strategy's bitcoin purchase fails to stir BTC price
Crypto.reason: Illustrates muted marginal demand despite buys — small-to-moderate negative for near-term BTC price momentum/liquidity.

Crypto.title: Is Bitcoin Too Boring for Investors in an AI World?
Crypto.reason: Thematic piece highlighting capital rotation into AI equities at crypto's expense — negative narrative for BTC allocation.

Crypto.title: Circle debuts cirBTC on Ethereum to challenge Coinbase in the wrapped bitcoin market
Crypto.reason: New wrapped-BTC product increases onchain liquidity/interoperability on Ethereum — modest positive for BTC utility and DeFi flows.

Crypto.title: Japan's three largest banks aim for joint stablecoin issue by March
Crypto.reason: Major incumbent banks issuing a stablecoin signals strong institutional adoption and regulatory-commercial integration — significant positive for crypto payment rails and onchain liquidity.

Crypto.title: UK financial regulator moves to allow mutual funds 10% exposure to crypto ETNs
Crypto.reason: Regulatory permission for mutual funds to hold crypto ETNs opens institutional channels and potential inflows — clear positive for market adoption and capital formation.

Crypto.title: A16z, Paradigm lead $175 million bet to move global credit markets onchain
Crypto.reason: Large VC capital into onchain credit infrastructure boosts long-term use cases and institutional interest — positive for crypto ecosystem growth.

Crypto.title: Trad.Fi, W3 target $650 million in onchain private credit using AI evaluation
Crypto.reason: Bridging TradFi credit to onchain with AI underwriting suggests incremental institutional capital and product development — positive adoption signal.

Crypto.title: Humanity's $36 million exploit tied to compromised laptop hosting a 'multisig' wallet
Crypto.reason: Large exploit undermines security/trust in multisig custody practices — material negative for institutional confidence and counterparty risk.

Crypto.title: Crypto tax bills a work-in-progress as U.S. House lawmakers pose concerns
Crypto.reason: Ongoing legislative uncertainty and contested tax provisions create regulatory risk and potential compliance costs — modest negative for market clarity and flows.

Crypto.title: Securitize CEO says tokenized stocks could unlock a $5 trillion crypto market
Crypto.reason: Tokenized equities narrative highlights large potential addressable market and additional use cases for crypto rails — positive but speculative adoption upside.

Crypto.title: Ethena lands Janus Henderson backing as asset manager invests in ENA, eyes USDe distribution
Crypto.reason: Traditional asset manager backing a crypto-native project increases institutional credibility for stablecoin/DeFi products — small-to-moderate positive.

Crypto.title: XRP market shows signs of capitulation as holders sell at loss
Crypto.reason: Altcoin-specific capitulation indicates weakness in speculative segments of crypto market; negative for altcoin risk appetite but lower relevance to broad BTC-led narrative.
